data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Sarapion', which is composed of the elements 'saros' meaning 'of the army' and 'pion' meaning 'lord'. In Christian tradition, Sarion may be considered a name for a man who is devoted to the Lord and is a leader or member of a Christian community. The name Sarion carries the meaning “Lord's man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek. Parents who choose Sarion usually hope their child will grow to embody lord's man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
